body:
Founder real-time: 'we need to integrate the model repository with git lfs and each model repository should have a git integration that can be turned off (on by default).' New internal/modelgit.Syncer -- syncs every newly-created RL checkpoint blob (SHANKPIT's own shankpit_rl_checkpoints, and the shared brawlpit_rl_checkpoints table used by BRAWLPIT+DEADWEIGHT) into that game's real sibling repo checkout on this box, under models/rl-checkpoints/, git-lfs-tracked. Fire-and-forget (never fails/blocks the real checkpoint upload). Extracted internal/gitsync.PushWithRetry from apples.go's own production-proven Apples-git-sync idiom into its own leaf package so modelgit could reuse it without an import cycle (kanban.go now also calls the extracted version -- zero behavior change, confirmed by re-running apples/kanban tests). Per-game toggle via <GAME>_MODEL_GIT_DISABLED (on by default -- Syncer{} zero value is enabled by construction, no constructor needed); <GAME>_MODEL_GIT_REPO_DIR overrides the destination path. 9 new tests: modelgit package (disabled/zero-value/unsafe-filename/real end-to-end git+lfs+push+fresh-clone round trip) plus a CheckpointStore-level integration test proving Create() really wires into GitSync with correct blob/filename/commit message, not just that Syncer works standalone. All existing tests green (apples/kanban/brawlpit/shankpit). Deployed to production, health check green. Real remote sync (against SHANKPIT/BRAWLPIT/DEADWEIGHT's own real GitHub repos) not yet exercised against production -- verified with real, throwaway local git+lfs repos instead, deliberately avoiding polluting the founder's own real project history with test commits.

⚓ ☃
title: Model repository git-lfs integration, per-game on/off toggle (on by default)
